data.name: Ecto Corporations
data.detailed_description:
You’ve inherited a bankrupt company and a cursed book. Now, you're the only one who can face the ghosts haunting the city.

In Ecto Corporations, you play as an unlikely ghost hunter who turns a crumbling building into the country’s greatest supernatural empire.

Start alone, armed with nothing but a metal rod, and build your reputation — for better or worse. Win over fans, challenge cultists, and recruit a team of paranormal experts. Manage resources, upgrade your base, explore a living city, and choose whether to become a hero… or the right hand of a dark organization.

⚙️ GAME STYLE

🧠 Simulation + Action + Narrative with Choices

  • A mix of paranormal business simulation, third-person exploration, light combat, and meaningful decisions.

  • Set in a dynamic open city with unique NPC routines, locations, and supernatural events.

🎮 GAMEPLAY FEATURES

🔧 Build Your Team

Hire paranormal specialists, train them, manage salaries, and keep them from panicking when facing the unknown.

🏚️ Upgrade Your Base

Turn a decaying building into a true ghost-hunting HQ, complete with labs, vehicles, and spiritual containment gear.

💀 Face Ghosts & Cultists

Use enchanted weapons, rituals, runes, and raw instinct to capture or destroy entities. But beware: some ghosts can possess NPCs, objects, or even vehicles.

🌇 Explore a Living City

Roam through haunted cemeteries, shady alleys, and mysterious shops. Interact with civilians — save them… or scare them.

📈 Build (or Break) Your Reputation

Your actions shape how the world reacts. Become a public hero with media support, or ally yourself with the shadows and cults that rule the beyond.

🧠 Manage Courage and Sanity

Your character isn’t immune to fear. Terrifying environments and spiritual attacks reduce your courage. If it hits zero, expect panic, fainting — or a hospital visit…

🚗 Use Urban Transport (or Steal a Car)

Buses, subways, NPC vehicles — use whatever you can. Or run for your life if a possessed car is chasing you.

🌟 HIGHLIGHTS

• Narrative campaign with dynamic supernatural events

• Courage, reputation, upgrade systems, and moral choices

• Semi-open world with day/night cycle and weather

• Unique characters with stories and secrets

• Blend of humor, mystery, and light psychological horror

• Visual style: PBR/ hand-drawn textures, cartoonish with a melancholic atmosphere.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core I3 6006U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520
  • DirectX: Version 10

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains frequent cartoon-style violence, including the use of melee and ranged weapons against humans and ghosts. Players can harm or kill civilians, which affects reputation. There are depictions of death, blood, and possession. Some areas contain disturbing imagery such as cemeteries, haunted houses, and corpses. Dark themes such as occult rituals, spiritual corruption, and psychological distress are present. The game includes moral choice systems that may lead the player to criminal actions or collaboration with dark factions.
Some characters wear revealing clothing, such as short shorts, which may expose parts of the body during movement (e.g., climbing stairs). These outfits are not presented in a sexualized context, and the camera does not focus on intimate areas.
